zoe: Heads-up: vendor StormForge confirmed for pen-test Wed 09:00 PT. Scope: prod api gateway, model-serving, artifact-store. Need RBAC snapshot, KMS ephemeral access, audit export, and retest booking. Who takes what? :spiral_notepad:
sam: I can own RBAC snapshot and vuln triage board. Post exact projects & SAs in-scope and Ill export.
kevin: Ill do KMS ephemeral role. Confirm decrypt-only for artifacts? @anita
anita: Decrypt-only ok. Legal wants evidence receipt signed. Default retention 90 days. Ensure manifests include signer name and checksum. Redact any user prompt content.
ryan: Ill run the audit export and set immutability on the evidence bucket. Will do pre-snapshot 15m before start and stream during window.
ops-bot: Temporary role request created PT-6123459999. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Link: https://ops.internal/requests/6123459999 :white_check_mark:
sam: Example RBAC export I'll run:
```
rbac-export --projects=prod,staging --out=rbac-6123459999.json
 gsutil cp rbac-6123459999.json gs://pt-evidence/6123459999/
```
kevin: IAM snippet will be time-bound with a condition; will submit PR with auto-remove.
anita: Add a manifest.csv with sha256 for each file and a signed acceptance form. No raw prompts or embeddings in exports.
zoe: Proposed retest windows Fri-Mon next week, two 2-hour slots each day. Sam create tracker with owners and severity buckets.
sam: On it will seed categories: creds, authz, data-leak, telemetry.
kevin: I'll add a short-lived middleware to log {request_id, route, latency_ms} for 48h behind a feature flag; rollback job included.
ryan: Abort conditions: if auth failures or 5xx >2x baseline, pause and notify execs. I'll add alerts and runbook steps.
zoe: Dry-run Thu 11:00am PT to rehearse evidence collection and role lifecycle. Please put any pre-engagement notes (whitelist IPs, special SAs) here before EOD Wed.
ops-bot: Dry-run invite posted to #eng-security. Reminder 15m before.
zoe: Use #release-war-room for emergency escalation during the test and tag me. Thanks.
